name: Pathoparalysis Mine
effect:
3/Scene, you can deploy a mine anywhere within Sensor range.

Whenever a hostile character gets within Burst 2, the mine explodes.
This will leave behind a Burst 2 cloud that whenever a biological character comes within, they gain the Pathoparalysis Status.

name: Neurax Worm
description: Unlike traditional system hacking, the Neurax Worm physically launches from the mech and burrows into the Target. This causes physical damage to the mech during this process as it attempts to take over.

actions.name: Launch Neurax Worm
actions.detail:
The Target must perform a Hull save and a Systems save.

If the Hull save fails, the Target takes 1d4 Kinetic damage that is considered Armor Piercing (AP).
If the Systems save fails, the Target takes 2 Heat.
